summary: This directory provides a standardized framework for performing CRUD operations on data entities. It bridges the gap between database schemas and application data logic by defining repository interfaces, synchronization strategies, and structural schemas for data persistence.
responsibilities: Defining generic repository interfaces for standard data operations
Deriving repository implementations from schema definitions
Calculating synchronization requirements between incoming and existing records
Validating definition keys against database table structures
Structuring schemas for insert, select, and update actions
relationships: CrudRepository interfaces leverage CrudSchemas to define the structure of data actions performed on database tables.
The diffEntities logic uses entity definitions to determine the necessary database mutations required to sync record states.
The repository implementation types derive their structure and capabilities directly from provided schema definitions.
designDecisions: Use of generic interfaces for modular CRUD operations
Separation of schema definitions from operational logic
Type-safe validation of table keys against data schemas
